title: New experience releases an earlier picture

captions.physics: Making concrete examples of the present

meaning: Your shared view can renew itself through concrete examples even when recognising changed conditions means releasing an earlier picture you valued.
text: A familiar explanation can stop fitting before your attachment to it disappears. The Empress in the physical position of Ajna suggests creating concrete examples and observing what happens under present conditions. The Wheel of Fortune in energy supports openness to change, a wish to understand events in their movement. Death in emotions describes the experience of an ending: an earlier picture loses its force, and parting with it may feel sad. Your understanding can develop while leaving this farewell a place beside the useful new thought.

Suppose you sketch several ways to spend a day somewhere you once loved visiting. A new map shows changed routes and building work. **You can acknowledge change while preserving the value of earlier experience.** It becomes clearer why the old description no longer helps you choose today’s outing. You may miss the familiar image although interesting possibilities have appeared. Those can find a place when earlier experience becomes a valued memory rather than a measure every new possibility must satisfy.

The difficulty is expecting recognition of the facts to remove sadness immediately. The new explanation then needs defending against your own attachment, as though useful understanding must bring instant pleasure. Your interest in changed conditions stays alive when feelings are allowed to move more slowly than conclusions. A shared view can become more accurate now while the emotional farewell to an earlier picture is still unfolding.
